Messages.Author: alek
Messages.Body: Can you use vagabond mystic's special to save jake washington (or any other ally that is reduced to zero blood during one damage resolution step or other damaging effect).

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
> Jake Washington (Hunter)
>
> Unique master.
> Put this card in play. While in play, this card represents a unique mortal ally with 1 life, 0 strength and 0 bleed and doesn't count as a master card. During your untap phase, you may burn Jake to move up to 4 blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire with no blood.
>
> Vagabond Mystic
>
> Unique mortal with 2 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
> Tap Vagabond Mystic to move 1 life counter from the blood bank to an ally you control who has fewer life than his or her starting amount. The Vagabond Mystic cannot block vampires.
>
> Complete wrote:
> An ally or retainer that has zero life counters is burned.
>
Also see the following ruling: [LSJ 20001111]

Thus the answer is "no", you cannot save an ally that way.
